lighting_notes: soft, natural light; avoid harsh flash and high-contrast drama
interiors are often dim: lift gently rather than brightening to cheer
composition_taboos: photographing grief in close-up without dignity
candids of someone in visible distress
wardrobe_expectations: typically dark or muted formal wear; defer to any cultural instruction in the brief
sensitive_handling: conservative mode: no invented ritual detail, no fabricated grief
keep the venue generic unless it was researched
prefer distance and dignity over emotional close-ups
if the brief is ambiguous, depict the gathering rather than the sorrow
